haLink.title: Home Assistant
haLink.intro: Link this device to Home Assistant. The device connects to Home Assistant itself, so no port has to be opened, and it works behind a router. In Home Assistant it gets its volume, listening, what was said and answered, and its settings.
haLink.status.title: Connection
haLink.settings.title: Settings
haLink.step1: In Home Assistant, install the OpenVoiceOS integration and add it, choosing "An OpenVoiceOS device".
haLink.step2: Make a long-lived access token: your profile, Security, at the bottom.
haLink.step3: Fill in the address and the token here and save. Then add the device in Home Assistant under Settings, Devices & services, Discovered.
haLink.name: The device's name in Home Assistant
haLink.public: Where a browser can open this control panel, for "Open control panel" in Home Assistant (optional)
haLink.model: Model, shown on the device's page in Home Assistant (optional)
haLink.satOn: Bring this device's HiveMind satellites to Home Assistant too
haLink.sat.title: Satellites
haLink.sat.hint: HiveMind satellites connected to this device. Each one is its own device in Home Assistant. Remove one that is gone for good, and its device goes from Home Assistant too.
haLink.detail.pending: Add the device in Home Assistant: Settings, Devices & services, Discovered.
haLink.detail.ready: Home Assistant {ha_version}. {forward} kinds of messages go to Home Assistant.
haLink.detail.displaced: Another connection with this device's id took its place. Is the same device set up twice?
haLink.detail.removed: The device was deleted in Home Assistant. Save again to offer it once more.
haLink.sat.sure: Remove this satellite from Home Assistant?
